requires.label: Colorado resident
requires.quote: Financial assistance is available for emergent or medically necessary care to all individuals who reside in Colorado and have established care with Vail Health.

requires.label: Emergent or medically necessary care
requires.quote: Financial assistance is available for emergent or medically necessary care to all individuals who reside in Colorado and have established care with Vail Health.

rules.label: Uninsured Eligibility
rules.quote: Eligibility for all uninsured patients will be is based on meeting residency and income requirements.

rules.label: Presumptive Eligibility
rules.quote: Eligibility in state or federally funded programs. Examples include housing assistance, food stamps and the Women, Infants & Children program (WIC).

rules.label: 100% discount for FPL <=250%
rules.quote: Patients eligible for financial assistance at less than 250% of Federal Poverty Level (FPL) will not be charged more than the amount collected from Vail Health’s lowest commercial contracted payer.

notes: Approval period: Once approved, financial assistance is valid for 12 months subsequent to approval.
Appeal process: Denials may be appealed; appeals reviewed within 30 days of receipt.
Incomplete application: Notice sent within 15 days of receipt; missing information must be returned within 30 days of notice.
Eligibility letter timing: Eligibility letter within 60 days; Colorado Hospital Discounted Care eligibility letter within 14 days of completed application.
Verification: Submitted documentation may be independently verified for completeness and accuracy.
Non-discrimination: No discrimination based on race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability.
Government program referral: Counselors assist in determining eligibility for government-sponsored programs and refer to outside resources.
Insurance exchange info: Counselors direct patients to information about insurance coverages through Colorado health insurance exchange.
Services excluded: Services by other providers (e.g., Vail Valley Surgery Center, Steadman Clinic, etc.) not eligible even if performed in Vail Health facility.
rule_uninsured_eligibility may leave out a condition: Missing residency requirement (co_resident and emergent/medically necessary care).
rule_presumptive_eligibility may leave out a condition: Missing residency and care type requirements (Colorado residency and emergent/medically necessary care).

dropped.quote: The Vail Health financial assistance program is only applicable for Vail Health medical bills. Services conducted by a different medical provider other than Vail Health (even if performed in a Vail Health facility) fall outside of the policy scope and are not eligible for Vail Health financial assistance.
dropped.why: Policy restricts assistance to Vail Health medical bills, not service area residency.

dropped.claim: The policy's deadline for a patient to SUBMIT a financial-assistance application is 240 days after the date of service (alone, or as one of several 'the later of' options)
dropped.quote: If a financial assistance application is received within 240 days of Vail Health’s initial billing for a service and is deemed incomplete...
dropped.why: 240-day limit is for receiving incomplete applications, not for submitting applications.

dropped.quote: Patients eligible for financial assistance at less than 250% of Federal Poverty Level (FPL) will not be charged more than the amount collected from Vail Health’s lowest commercial contracted payer.
dropped.why: Policy limits charges to lowest commercial payer rate, not stating 100% discount.
